title: Cotton 2 (Japan): built-in compatibility edit
summary: Preserve SAROO's cartridge timing by skipping the game's ASR0 write.
rationale: A00.BIN writes 0x23301FF0 to the SCU A-bus CS0/CS1 timing register at 0x25FE00B0. The upstream callback NOPs that store at 0x06004194; this overlay preserves the same edit. Sega's SCU manual, Figure 3.24 (page 62), requires A-bus settings to account for the connected devices. The original source does not identify the specific compatibility symptom.

writes.effect: Replace MOV.L R1,@R2 at 0x06004194 with NOP, suppressing the 0x23301FF0 ASR0 store.
writes.reason: Retain the loader's A-bus timing rather than applying the game's cartridge settings; matches upstream cotton2_patch.
